verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Feature Gates (feature flags) that change product behavior in real time without redeploying, and SDK checkGate calls to evaluate them. A community user also reports adopting it as a LaunchDarkly alternative. However, nothing in the evidence describes how gates are targeted or rolled out, so the specific mechanisms this story asks about are unproven. missing for 10: documented targeting by user properties, cohort/segment targeting, percentage-based rollout rules for gates, independent hands-on corroboration of targeted rollouts.
